$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Cloud KMS. See s3.json for the contract. Feature ids share one namespace with AWS; GCP ids start with 'gcp.'.

gcp.kms.keyring.crud.title: Key rings (create, get, list across locations)

gcp.kms.key.rotation.title: Key rotation (rotation period + manual Rotate key)
limitations: The rotation period and next rotation time are stored and returned exactly as configured, but Vyomi has no background scheduler — it never rotates a key on its own; use "Rotate key" or wait for an external caller to do it.

gcp.kms.key.versions.title: Key versions (create, make primary, enable, disable, destroy, restore)

gcp.kms.key.permissions.title: Permissions (IAM policy on a key)
limitations: getIamPolicy/setIamPolicy store and return the policy exactly as written, but Vyomi does not evaluate it — it never denies or allows a KMS call based on policy content.

gcp.kms.inventory.title: Key inventory (project-wide key search across all key rings and locations)

gcp.kms.autokey.title: Autokey (automatic per-resource key ring/key provisioning)
limitations: Autokey provisions key rings and keys automatically when a resource is created, gated by an organization/folder policy and a dedicated key project. Vyomi doesn't model org policy or cross-project key provisioning, so there is nothing to wire this to.
